Context: Leave Salary Contribution:

A person drawing emoluments as Basic Pay i 36,000 and Dearness Allowance t 50,400 (DA @ 140%) with increment @ 3% per annum on the basic pay is appointed in Central Government in the Level 11 of Pay Matrix (in Seventh CPC) with DA@ 15% on deputation basis. What will be his pay in the ex cadre post?
